summary: Notes that command and shell modules care about return codes, so a command whose success exit code isn't zero can be wrapped as `somecommand || /bin/true`.
questions: My command exits non-zero on success, how do I stop Ansible failing it?
How do I ignore the result of a shell command?

answer_card.title: Commands with non-zero success codes
answer_card.answer_md:
`command` and `shell` fail on non-zero return codes. If your command's successful exit code isn't zero, you can force success in shell:

```yaml
- name: Run this command and ignore the result
  ansible.builtin.shell: /usr/bin/somecommand || /bin/true
```
